photos.title: Chocolate Censorship
photos.description:
Human body is very attractive, for centuries it captures attention of artists and viewers.
Modern era has brought us censorship - if a baby can't chew a steak, the man will not get it either - this is the essence of instagram, facebook etc. social networks content policy. 
On the other hand, we got used to pictures that are artificially refined, sweetened and adopted to call for saturated emotions in the mind of a user.
Here is the attempt to depict the refinement and censorship action. All in one. Just to keep it simple. Thanks for reading this, be happy.

photos.title: Trust Fall
photos.description: I took this in Iceland while shooting in a geothermal area that was outgassing sulphuric steam. This shot was my favorite, so much suspense and story play into the seemingly perilous image. Don't worry, she's fine.
